title: msg.value, payable and balance semantics
why: Native-token transfers differ fundamentally: 18-decimal wei on anvil vs planck with existential deposits on pallet-contracts; solang maps msg.value/payable onto a different balance model. Balances are recorded but never compared — so look for status/revert divergence instead.
hints: Call a payable function with value from alice, then forward funds via address(this).balance checks (returned, not compared).
Non-payable function called with value > 0 — does it revert on both chains?
receive()/fallback() triggered by a call to a missing function name (compile may reject — that is a finding too).
transfer/send (may be unsupported by solang — COMPILE_ASYMMETRY).
